sources.role: United States national administrative level 2 county polygons; source lineage comparator for exact 279 IDs
sources.vintage: Boundary year 2018; source data update 2023-01-19; upstream build 2023-12-12; immutable commit 9469f09592ced973a3448cf66b6100b741b64c0d dated 2023-12-13

license.terms: Pinned upstream metadata states Public Domain and cites U.S. Census Bureau MAF/TIGER Database; this records the upstream statement, not legal advice or a legal boundary certification.

sources.description: Full and simplified GeoJSON plus metadata match retained LFS object digests; raw pointer bytes and retrieval outcomes are retained. The catalog hash maps to simplifiedGeometryGeoJSON. all.zip and TopoJSON payload objects were not retrieved; their exact LFS pointers and object IDs are retained.

methods.description: Read retained GeoJSON and metadata; verify Git LFS pointers against object bytes; compare exact shapeID inventories/counts and scoped IDs; scan all world-index parts for unique Atlas occurrence; compare Atlas parent links to prior #428 Census crosswalk rows. No geometry overlay or legal-boundary adjudication is performed.
methods.software: Python 3 standard library; Git; repository scripts/evidence-quality.mjs
methods.units: features, shape IDs, subjects, vertices; binary geometry equality

conclusions.text: For this exact 279-ID scope, each Atlas source ID joins one-to-one to the corresponding full and simplified 2018 GeoBoundaries feature by exact shapeID; the national variants each contain 3,233 unique shapeIDs, matching metadata count.

The repository catalog sha256 identifies the simplifiedGeometryGeoJSON LFS object, not the full-resolution GeoJSON. Both hashes and exact object sizes are verified against immutable commit 9469f09592ced973a3448cf66b6100b741b64c0d.
The product count and hash lineage do not establish legal boundaries, currentness, universal county equivalence, shoreline/island completeness, or the wider custom region's meaning.

notes: Preserve data/administrative-sources.json sha256=16249e8d795aaded6a72910a8c72115a073814b25ee902d61ccc9a9490c6641a; it matches the declared simplifiedGeometryGeoJSON artifact. If engineering needs an unambiguous checksum contract, document the hash target/path in a separate scoped engineering change. Per-subject County role/state parent is cross-referenced to the already reviewed #428 packet. This source-lineage audit does not repeat that packet's boundary comparison or convert Census TIGER/CBF overlap into legal correctness.
The packet completes source hash lineage for issue #981 scope; it does not certify the 279 subjects as legally/currently correct or certify the wider region.
